chemistry.source_basis: Actual earlier JSON case text inspected; activity-method fit compared with the downloaded official NIE Chemistry Practical Handbook. All numbers below independently recomputed in Python. No source publication or teacher validation claimed.
chemistry.summary: No incorrect final numerical Chemistry answers found among these17 cases. Two unit-display substitutions omit an explicit factor1000 although the final enthalpy numbers are correct. Several associated enrichment questions are not proof of method-specific handbook coverage; V5 supplies direct cases. Source38 solvent-name contradiction is explicitly documented.

cases.title: Burette reading and stated uncertainty
cases.verification_scope: Original case and complete mark guide read; stated numerical model recomputed where quantitative; units, stoichiometry, limitations and NIE activity-method fit reviewed. No teacher review claimed.
cases.interpretation_assessment: Correct under explicitly declared worst-case uncertainty addition; no unsupported statistical quadrature claim.
cases.activity_alignment: Direct measurement/glassware skill; consistent with activity3.

cases.title: Gas quantity from a teacher-supplied dataset
cases.verification_scope: Original case and complete mark guide read; stated numerical model recomputed where quantitative; units, stoichiometry, limitations and NIE activity-method fit reviewed. No teacher review claimed.
cases.interpretation_assessment: Correct ideal-gas units and temperature reasoning. Dry-gas/pressure corrections are not modelled.
cases.activity_alignment: Associated gas-law enrichment, not actual oxygen-mass-loss molar-volume determination. V5 PM5-C05 supplies method-specific coverage.

cases.title: Hess cycle with a reversed step
cases.verification_scope: Original case and complete mark guide read; stated numerical model recomputed where quantitative; units, stoichiometry, limitations and NIE activity-method fit reviewed. No teacher review claimed.
cases.interpretation_assessment: Correct because matched stoichiometric normalisation and chemical states are explicitly stated.
cases.activity_alignment: Hess-law associated symbolic model, compatible principle; not an experimental calorimetry dataset.

cases.title: Evidence of a changed coordination environment
cases.verification_scope: Original case and complete mark guide read; stated numerical model recomputed where quantitative; units, stoichiometry, limitations and NIE activity-method fit reviewed. No teacher review claimed.
cases.interpretation_assessment: Interpretive claims are appropriately conditional: spectral shift is consistent with changed environment, and no unique ligand/coordination identity is claimed. Concentration/path length mainly affect absorbance magnitude in simple systems; overlapping species, pH or temperature can change observed broad maxima.
cases.activity_alignment: Associated spectroscopic enrichment to activity18 colour comparisons; no practical colour observations for specific ions.

issues.detail: Concentration/path-length changes should not be said to shift lambda_max of a single ideal unchanged species by themselves; existing text says they complicate interpretation rather than explicitly cause the shift, so no mandatory correction.

cases.title: Predicting salt-solution acidity conceptually

cases.interpretation_assessment: NH4Cl acidic, carbonate basic, NaCl approximately neutral and NH4NO3 acidic are correct for stated dilute model.
cases.activity_alignment: Direct hydrolysis/pH concept alignment to35; qualitative prediction rather than measured pH dataset.

cases.title: An apparent partition ratio

cases.activity_alignment: Direct phase-concentration interpretation to38; source solvent-name discrepancy does not change these supplied ratio calculations.

issues.detail: NIE activity38 heading says2-butanol while its actual method names butan-1-ol. This case does not specify a solvent or universal constant, so its arithmetic remains valid; V5 documents source ambiguity.

physics.scope: All 17 existing Physics cases only: V3.1 eight, V3.2 five, V3.3 four. Numerical answers, transfers, dimensional/sign checks and obvious physical consistency reviewed against supplied data. Not a full PDF-layout audit, independent teacher review, or complete laboratory-procedure audit.
physics.overall_finding: Two known required overlays confirmed; no additional substantive numerical or physical defects found in the other 15 Physics cases. One minor logic-gate wording improvement and optional resonance tube-length clarification recorded.
physics.cross_release_note: V3.2 has six mark points per question, consistent with marks_per_question=6; V3.3 has eight, consistent with marks_per_question=8. Do not flatten these into five-mark totals without rewriting. Fictional teacher-written/supplied scenario labels do not establish actual teacher review; all release teacher_reviewed flags are false.

issues.finding: Displayed k≈9.95 N m^-1 is rounded incorrectly. Both the displayed average 3.965 and the exact mean 3.96475 give k≈9.96 to two decimal places.
Original first/second lengths 0.18/0.53 m imply e=-0.005 m, inconsistent with the ordinary positive open-end correction model.
issues.required_overlay: Use first 0.17 m and second 0.52 m; separation and speed remain 0.35 m and 336 m s^-1. Update the worked subtraction too. The corrected e is +0.005 m.

issues.finding: A second resonance at 0.52 m requires usable tube length exceeding 0.52 m if any apparatus size is stated. The legacy case states no tube size, so no additional defect is established.
issues.required_overlay: Optional: specify a hypothetical tube with usable length at least 0.55 m if adding a tube dimension.

issues.finding: The misconception says an OR gate is similar in the “three other rows”; NAND and OR actually agree in only rows 01 and 10 and differ in rows 00 and 11. The conclusion and supplied explanation that they differ at 00 and 11 are correct.
issues.recommended_text: NAND and OR agree for 01 and 10 but differ for 00 and 11; inspect all four rows.

cases.physical_note: The inferred effective-mass offset is intercept/slope = 0.10/3.90 = 0.0256 kg; plausible as an unmodelled spring/pan mass contribution.
Alpha is explicitly referenced to 20 degrees C; no error from using slope/R20. The extrapolated R0 would differ, so do not silently relabel alpha20 as alpha0.
Positive e=0.007 m and quarter-wave lengths imply plausible sound speed and no negative correction. Millisecond-to-second conversion is correct.
Y=2.037e11 Pa is steel-like; doubling diameter at fixed other values makes inferred Y one quarter, as stated.
